title: Make evaluation check exemptions honor failed registered-run aggregates
outcome: A failed or indeterminate registered aggregate reported after an evaluation's cut cannot preserve freshness merely because its completed stages passed.
acceptance: ExemptChecks::after consults genuine shared producer facts and does not exempt a passing stage when its registered aggregate did not succeed; historical execution-observation semantics stay unchanged.
A regression with a failed aggregate and only passing emitted stages after the evaluated cut requires resubmission when the Git revision and sighting align; include an indeterminate aggregate.
The change preserves passing same-revision exemptions, evidence cuts, exact replay, and existing mutation handling.
